name: VCPlus Limited
summary: VCPlus Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, production, and sale of gold properties in Malaysia. It operates through Gold mining, Granite Business, and Corporate & Others segments. The company is also involved in the exploration, mining, quarry extraction, processing, and sale of granite products and dimension stone granites, as well as marble, aggregates, and related products. Its properties include the Lubuk Mandi and Bukit Chetai mines located in Terengganu, Malaysia. In addition, the company undertakes architectural stone and interior fit-out contracts; provides gold and related mineral mining consultancy services; offers business and management consultancy services; and operates as a contractor of natural resources, as well as undertakes general trading activities. The company was formerly known as Anchor Resources Limited and changed its name to VCPlus Limited in April 2021. VCPlus Limited was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
